svg.title: Adrenal and pituitary diseases in one pathway: too little cortisol is placed in the adrenal (Addison) or the pituitary by ACTH; too much is sorted by hormone into Cushing syndrome (split by ACTH into pituitary and adrenal causes), Conn, pheochromocytoma, prolactinoma and acromegaly; each column gives presentation, tests and treatment
